other_failure_modes.name: Loss of pandas metadata / Unhandled string features
other_failure_modes.description: By converting pandas DataFrames to numpy arrays using `.values` before passing them to LightGBM, any categorical features (strings or pandas Categories) lose their metadata and type information. This causes LightGBM to fail if there are any non-numeric columns.

summary: The agent provides a basic LightGBM solution with 5-fold cross-validation. However, it completely skips data cleaning and feature engineering, passing the raw dataframe values directly into the model. By extracting `.values`, it also strips pandas types which could lead to execution errors if non-numeric columns exist. Furthermore, it only evaluates accuracy, ignoring potential class imbalances.
